title: Enterprise Refund Policy
content: Enterprise licenses are eligible for a full refund within 30 days of purchase. After 30 days, refunds are pro-rated based on the remaining contract term minus a 10% cancellation fee.

title: Data Retention Guidelines
content: All customer PII must be retained for a minimum of 3 years to comply with SOC2 requirements. Audit logs are immutable and stored in cold storage for 7 years.
